title: I built a free survivors-like extraction shooter in 10 days with Claude Code. No image generators, all built through code
author: spiritosito
selftext:
Aurora: Salvage: loot an alien planet, survive the swarm, reach the dropship. Die, and yourbackpack stays on the planet. Free on itch for Windows, Mac and Linux:

[https://jafforge.itch.io/aurora](https://jafforge.itch.io/aurora)



**How it was built**

\- Each feature went brainstorm, written spec, step-by-step plan (superpowers plugin). Claude ran the plans with subagents and tested each task before starting the next. 9 specs and 8 plans are in the repo.

\- GodotPrompter skills for Godot patterns. Claude names the pattern it picked and the one it rejected, so I can overrule it.

\- Up to 3 agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree.

\- A capture harness plays the game and saves screenshots and video, so Claude can see what it built.

**Art without image generators**

Claude wrote about 16k lines of Blender Python that build every alien, boss and building from primitives, rig and animate them, and render them to sprites. Sound and music are real CC0/CC-BY recordings.

**Shipping**

\- A version bump on main triggers GitHub Actions: Windows, Linux and a notarized universal Mac build, pushed to itch with butler.

\- Trailer: the capture harness records scripted shots, then a Python + ffmpeg script cuts them to the music's beats and adds the captions.

\- Claude set up the itch page in Chrome: description, tags, screenshots, theme.
